Resolves #19604

The 13.2 notes' final iteration. The Dock leads now: the TL;DR, the 2-minute block with its one line, and the chapter order (Dock → split → Grid; the split chapter moved verbatim). The header carries the designation, the film sits under the TL;DR, the Dock chapter shows its declarative API in code, and a Full Changelog closes the document. Mnemosyne's reader's check ([6110606556](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/14800#issuecomment-6110606556)) is folded: all seven findings.

**The header, rendered from the operator's ruling; it ships as written unless he objects.** Your ruling ([6110675327](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/14800#issuecomment-6110675327)): "as close to a major release as it gets, without being breaking. massive features release." The header says *with the package's entry points unchanged* rather than *non-breaking*, because the upgrade tables list removed experimental Dock files and behavior changes that need action. Stability: Stable.

Evidence: L2 (the Portal's render of the staged note on a local dev server; the Dock snippet executed as a unit spec) → L4 required for AC-6 (the film playing publicly, the cover's raw URL serving). Residual: AC-6, Residual-Owner: #14800.
